description_zh: 修改站点监控的探测任务
name: ModifyTask

parameters.help_en: The detection frequency. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 1, 5, and 15. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 探测频率，单位是分钟, 取值范围1、5、15，默认值为1
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The detection point information. Obtain this information by calling the DescribeISPAreaCity operation
parameters.help_zh: 探针的信息，需要从DescribeISPAreaCity 接口获得
parameters.name: isp_city

parameters.help_en: The advanced options for the monitoring protocol
parameters.help_zh: 监控对应协议的高级扩展选项
parameters.name: options

parameters.help_en:
The alert rules to set when you create or modify a task. The value is in the JSON array format. Example:
[{"alarmActions":["xxx"],"metricName":"Availability","expression":"$Availability<96"}]

alarmActions: the alert contact group. 

metricName: the metric. Valid values: Availability (the percentage of available detection points) and AvailableNumber (the number of available detection points)
parameters.help_zh:
创建/修改任务的时候同时设置报警规则,格式为jsonArray，例如
[{"alarmActions":["xxx"],"metricName":"Availability","expression":"$Availability<96"}]

alarmActions:对应的报警联系组 

metricName：对应的监控项，可以取值为Availability(可用探测点百分比), AvailableNumber(可用探测点数)
parameters.name: alert_rule

parameters.help_en: The IDs of existing alert rules to associate with the task. Separate multiple alert rule IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 直接关联已经存在等报警规则， 这里直接写报警规则Id，多个用规则用逗号分割
parameters.name: alert_ids

parameters.help_en: The product that calls this API operation. Default value: CloudMonitor. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 记录调用api的产品方，默认为云监控，您无需填写该参数
parameters.name: caller

parameters.help_en: The unit of the monitoring frequency. Use this parameter together with Interval. For example, if you set this parameter to ms, the minimum value of Interval is 15000 (15 seconds). Valid values: s: seconds. ms: milliseconds. Note: You must activate Hybrid Cloud Monitoring before you can use this parameter. For more information about how to activate Hybrid Cloud Monitoring, refer to Activate Hybrid Cloud Monitoring
parameters.help_zh: 监控频率的单位。该参数需要与Interval配合使用，例如：该参数设置为ms，Interval最小设置为15000（15秒）。取值：                              s：秒。ms：毫秒。说明 您必须开通秒级监控，才能使用该参数。关于如何开通秒级监控，请参见开通企业云监控
parameters.name: interval_unit

Code.description_en:
The status code.

A value of 200 indicates success

Message.example: The request has failed due to a temporary failure of the server.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: Successful.

false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
